meta_description: Farlow Painting & Decorating in Leicester. Professional interior and exterior painting. Free quotes, reliable service. Call 07501 053965.
hero_subhead: Transform your home or business with expert decorating. Free quotes, no obligation, Leicester-wide.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to full exterior repaints, we handle residential and commercial projects with care and expertise.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Transform living rooms, bedrooms, and kitchens with quality emulsion and specialist finishes. We prepare surfaces properly and deliver a clean, professional finish every time.

services.title: Exterior Repainting
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior paint. We handle fascias, soffits, doors, and full house repaints — protected against Leicester's UK climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Hanging and removal of wallpaper, including modern feature wall designs. We measure, plan, and execute with precision for a flawless finish.

services.title: Commercial & Office Decoration
services.desc: Keep your business looking sharp. We work around your schedule to refresh offices, shops, and industrial units without disruption.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Sand, prime, and paint internal and external woodwork to restore colour and protection. Doors, skirting, architrave — all finished to a high standard.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Work
services.desc: Proper preparation is everything. We patch, sand, fill, and prime all surfaces so paint adheres perfectly and lasts longer.

about_pullquote: I started Farlow because I believe you deserve honest painters who turn up on time and do the job right.
about_para_1: Farlow Painting & Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Leicester for nearly two decades. Founded on a straightforward principle — show up early, listen to what the customer wants, and leave them delighted — we've built a reputation for reliable, no-fuss service. Every member of our team is experienced, insured, and trained in the latest techniques and materials.
about_para_2: Whether you're refreshing a single room or redecorating an entire property, we treat your home as our own. Repeat customers make up the bulk of our work, which tells you everything about how we operate. We don't use pressure sales, we quote fairly, and we take pride in leaving your property cleaner than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Used Farlow to decorate our lounge and hallway. Really professional team, very tidy workers, and they finished a day early. Would definitely recommend to anyone. Prices were fair too.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen and downstairs painted before our daughter's wedding reception. Got straight through to them, they were able to fit us in at short notice, and the work was immaculate. Not a drop of paint out of place. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Catherine L.

reviews.text: Had them repaint the outside of the house — fascias, gutters, doors, the lot. Weather was grim but they got through it without hassle. Very professional, honest lads. Will use them again when the interior needs doing.
reviews.author: David H.
